citation: Photographic face-texture processing of retained, individually credited portraits and labelled stand-ins (T-3762, 26 November 2026). Original archive citations remain in their source records.
author: Project texture processing; original photographers and archives credited individually
describes_date: 1904 scene; source photograph and publication dates retained separately
repository: Input files, crop coordinates and SHA-256 values: assets/authored/humans/historical_photo_faces/SOURCE.json. Each face retains original_source, reference_source and shape_from; no archive identity is replaced by this processing record.
locator: 25 retained portrait crops; individual archive source IDs and photo inputs are listed in the lineage and per-person historical face metadata. The two new owner-chosen Stirling references retain separate source records.
rights_note: This records project processing, not a new historical photograph. Each original is recorded public_domain or no_known_restrictions; the original archive rights statements and links remain authoritative. All 25 existing source/crop identities and stand-in labels are preserved; no facial detail is generated. CC0 MakeHuman/Toigo skin supplies unobserved areas.

rights_checked.method: Reuse of the existing identified, retained portrait pixels against their original archive reuse statements.
rights_checked.outcome: cleared for the owner-requested texture derivation; individual original sources and input hashes retained

access_notes: Twenty own-person portraits and five explicitly labelled staff stand-ins. Camera registration preserves their existing fitted heads. Monochrome colour and unobserved depth/hair remain reconstructed. This project-processing record does not independently establish a person’s identity or appearance.
what_it_supplies: bhm_umfa53226_1855_hembitrade_anna_akerman: public_domain; Bohusläns museum marks the image Public Domain Mark 1.0 (K-samsök mediaLicense 'pdmark'; Europeana edmRights PDM 1.0). A studio photograph of about 1890-1895; under Swedish law the protection of a simple photographic picture made before 1969 has expired.
chicago_tribune_society_women_1907: public_domain; Published in the United States in 1907; copyright term expired. MSU identifies the publication date and provides a direct scan of the printed page.

chm_ichi_061818_frances_glessner_conservatory_1892: public_domain; The museum's record marks the image 'No Copyright - United States'; a photograph made in 1892 is out of copyright in the United States. Credit: Chicago History Museum, ICHi-061818.

glessner_blog_mattie_williamson_portrait_1890s: public_domain; The post gives no credit line or rights statement for this image. The photograph was made in the 1890s by its caption; a photograph made before 1906 is out of copyright in the United States whether or not it was published (published before 1931, or unpublished and more than 120 years old with no named author). The museum's digitisation adds no new copyright under US law for a faithful copy. Credit as: Glessner House Museum. The museum may hold the original and could be asked for a better scan.
glessner_commercial_club_1910_keith_plate: public_domain; United States publication before 1931; public domain. Original page and caption visually read.

glessner_commercial_club_1910_presidents_plate: public_domain; A book printed in the United States in 1910, in the public domain; the Library of Congress states it is unaware of any copyright restrictions on the item.
hall_successful_men_1896: public_domain; United States publication before 1931; public domain. Original page and caption visually read.
harris_ewing_pullman_1908: public_domain; US copyright registration H105262 in 1908; term expired. Wikimedia Commons reproduces the LOC catalogue and identifies the image as public domain.

loc_cph_3b15107_ge_house_maid_ironing_1908: no_known_restrictions; The Library of Congress states 'No known restrictions on publication.' A photograph copyrighted in 1908 is in the public domain in the United States.

loc_stereo_1s27248_achill_spinning_wheel_1903: no_known_restrictions; The Library of Congress states 'No known restrictions on publication.' A stereograph copyrighted in 1903 is in the public domain in the United States.

vbg_vmvp3391_nordstrom_kusk_1903: public_domain; K-samsök (the Swedish heritage aggregator, record built 2026-11) gives the image licence as Public Domain Mark 1.0 ('pdmark'). Europeana's older copy of the record gives CC BY-SA 4.0 instead; the museum's current feed is taken as authoritative here, and the conflict is recorded. A studio photograph made in 1903 is out of protection under Swedish law (simple photographic pictures made before 1969).

vlm_blom_p157_kusken_kalen: public_domain; Västmanlands läns museum marks the image Public Domain Mark 1.0 (K-samsök mediaLicense 'pdmark'; Europeana edmRights PDM 1.0). If the negative is from the 1920s rather than earlier, the museum's mark is still the stated status; under Swedish law a simple photographic picture made before 1969 is out of protection.
witherspoon_men_of_illinois_1902: public_domain; Published in the United States in 1902; publication predates 1931 and is in the US public domain. The title/copyright leaf states Chicago, 1902.
what_it_does_not_supply: A new historical reading, an unlabelled identity substitution, colour evidence from monochrome photographs, or unseen profile measurements.
